parameters.query:
INSERT INTO emails (account_id, provider, provider_message_id, thread_id, participants, subject, body, raw_payload, labels, received_at)
VALUES ($1, 'gmail', $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
ON CONFLICT (account_id, provider, provider_message_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Inserted?
nodes.notes: 004-triage, T5: a duplicate delivery (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING skipped the insert, inserted=false) never triggers Triage Pipeline -- only a genuinely new row does (FR1/AC4). Purely additive: this node and 'Call Triage Pipeline' are the only change this task makes to this already-live workflow.

nodes.name: Call Triage Pipeline
nodes.notes: 004-triage FR2/NFR2: fires Triage Pipeline non-blocking (waitForSubWorkflow: false) so Gemini's latency/availability can never affect this already-verified ingestion path (002-ingestion AC1-AC5). References the 'Triage Pipeline' sub-workflow BY NAME (cachedResultName), same placeholder pattern this file's own callers already use -- workflowId.value is left blank until triage-pipeline.json is imported and this node is re-pointed at it via n8n's resource picker.

nodes.name: Call Action Extraction
nodes.notes: 005-action-items, T3: second parallel branch off 'Inserted?'s true output, alongside 'Call Triage Pipeline' -- same guard (a genuinely new, non-duplicate insert), same non-blocking pattern (waitForSubWorkflow: false) so this new call can never affect this already-verified ingestion path. References the 'Action Extraction' sub-workflow BY NAME (cachedResultName) -- workflowId.value is left blank until action-extraction.json is imported and this node is re-pointed at it via n8n's resource picker. Passes received_at (Normalize's ISO timestamp) as the reference date Action Extraction needs to resolve relative deadlines.
